meta.name: deep-research
meta.description: Multi-agent research orchestration: split a research goal into parallel sub-goals, run each via headless `claude -p` subprocesses, aggregate results into a polished report file. Use for systematic web/document research, competitive or industry analysis, batch link/dataset processing, and long-form evidence synthesis. Triggers: "深度调研", "deep research", "wide research", "多 Agent 调研", "系统调研".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把调研目标拆解成并行子任务，自动汇总成报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要系统化搜集信息并生成结构化报告
copy.tagline_en: Split research goals into parallel subtasks and auto-aggregate into reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need systematic information gathering and structured report generation

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把一个调研目标拆成多个子任务，并行启动子进程分别研究，最后汇总成一份完整的报告文件，并给出关键结论。
howto.when: 当你说出“深度调研”、“deep research”、“wide research”、“多 Agent 调研”或“系统调研”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我深度调研一下新能源汽车行业的最新趋势。
say.note: Claude 会拆分子任务并行调研，最终生成报告文件。

say.text: 做一次竞品分析，对比苹果、三星和华为的旗舰手机。
say.note: Claude 会并行收集各品牌信息并整合报告。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude splits a research goal into parallel sub-tasks, runs subprocesses to research each, then aggregates results into a polished report file with key findings.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say keywords like "深度调研", "deep research", "wide research", "多 Agent 调研", or "系统调研".

say_en.text: Do a deep research on the latest trends in the new energy vehicle industry.
say_en.note: Claude will split tasks, run parallel research, and output a report file.

say_en.text: Conduct a competitive analysis of Apple, Samsung, and Huawei flagship phones.
say_en.note: Claude will gather info in parallel and produce a consolidated report.
